svg.title: Acceptance needs three independent gates
svg.desc: Three independent evidence pillars feed a handover decision. Cloud evidence requires a completed operation and current Arc and extension status. Local infrastructure evidence requires verified membership and quorum plus healthy storage and network. Workload management evidence requires a ready bridge and extension and approved image, network and storage paths. All required gates must pass; record exceptions and operational owners. Platform acceptance is not application certification.
svg.text: Read evidence pillars 1–3 from left to right, then make decision 4.

g.text: Record exceptions and assign operational owners.

svg.text: Platform acceptance is not application certification.
